title: #229 Technological Development
prompt: Nowadays, with the rapid development of technology, it is easy for people to prepare food. Has it improved the people’s quality of life? Discuss it with your own experience.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

modelPlan.focus: Evaluate the impact of technological advancements on food preparation and their effect on quality of life.
keyArguments: Technological innovations have made food preparation more convenient, saving time and effort.
However, reliance on technology may lead to a decline in culinary skills and the nutritional value of meals.
